title: Postil
summary: POS'TIL, noun [Latin post.] A marginal note; originally, a note in the margin of the Bible, so called because written after the text. POS'TIL, verb transitive To write marginal notes; to gloss; to ill

inlines.v: POS'TIL, noun [Latin post.] A marginal note; originally, a note in the margin of the Bible, so called because written after the text. POS'TIL, verb transitive To write marginal notes; to gloss; to illustrate with marginal notes.
